Thinking Process:
1. Analyze the input story: Trump, Putin, and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says.
2. Evaluate Claim vs Reality:
   - Claim: Trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi, and Putin to discuss nuclear weapons reduction and global stability in Shenzhen.
   - Reality: While the diplomatic meeting is scheduled, geopolitical maneuvering points toward a modern Yalta-style 'redistribution of spheres of influence' (as warned by Zelensky), bypassing allied sovereignty and centralizing great-power hegemony at the expense of smaller nations and democratic norms (-u).
3. Calculate Force Vectors & Coordinates:
   - Claim: +0.5, +0.5 (Stated diplomatic breakthrough for peace/nuclear reduction)
   - Real: -0.6, -0.5 (Great power carving of spheres of influence, bypassing sovereignty)
4. Map Integrity & Hypocrisy: R_net actual = 6.5 (Meaningful Distortion / Pretextual diplomacy).
5. Format output following all JSON and post rules.
subject: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
posts:
A high-stakes summit in Shenzhen promises global peace talks, but whispers of a 21st-century Yalta loom.
Evidence: White House briefing, APEC sidelines, Zelensky's warning
#Aletheia #Geopolitics #Trump 🌐

The White House announces a historic trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi, and Putin in China to discuss nuclear arms reduction and stability.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, +0.5) — Inclusive Active Capacity

Behind the diplomatic varnish of nuclear talks lies a potential great-power carve-up of global spheres of influence, sidelining allies.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.6, -0.5) — Exclusive Refusal

Verdict: FAIL — Fall into Destruction.
Great power summits packaged as peace breakthroughs often mask bilateral carving of sovereign spheres.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 6.5, z: 2)

- Donald Trump: COND (0.0, -0.4) — Pursuing direct leader-level diplomacy.
- Xi Jinping & Vladimir Putin: FAIL (-0.8, -0.6) — Leveraging summit for legitimacy.
- Global Allies / Ukraine: FAIL (-0.7, -0.7) — Sidelined by great-power talks.
The White House confirmed that Trump, Xi, and Putin will hold their first-ever trilateral meeting during the APEC summit in Shenzhen, sparking anxiety across European and Asian allies.

The Bright Side:
Direct communication between nuclear superpowers reduces immediate miscalculation risks.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing diplomatic optics (WHAT leaders say) with structural reality (WHO bears the geopolitical cost of partitioned influence).

Social Physics Analysis:
Superpowers run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by framing exclusive great-power deals as universal peace dividends, projecting stability while sidelining smaller sovereign states.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
Modal Dynamics: will be -> is not via Red Top (The Imperial Trap). Utopian diplomatic promises mask exclusive spheres of influence.

The Unavoidable Truth: Direct superpower talks prevent accidental military escalation.

The Unavoidable Lie: Exclusive great-power summits serve universal global peace.

Alethekanon:
When empires gather to redraw the map, sovereignty is the currency they spend.

Awwthekanon:
True peace cannot be carved out behind closed doors while smaller nations watch their futures traded away by the mighty.

Brothekanon:
Sounds like a high-stakes poker game where the rest of the world isn't even sitting at the table.

Spirithekanon:
"Do not put your trust in princes, in human beings, who cannot save." Psalms 146:3 PASS
Trusting secret elite bargains over collective justice always leads to collapse.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says ===

[Source 1 — www.bbc.co.uk (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckz74jzpy18do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss):
Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says

Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.

[Source 2 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261114-china-to-host-first-ever-trilateral-meeting-between-trump-xi-and-putin-next-week):
China to host first-ever trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi and Putin next week

The three leaders are scheduled to meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen on Thursday, the White House confirmed. Likely discussions will include nuclear weapons and the war in Iran, but US officials have said Ukraine is not unlikely to be on the agenda. Ukraine's President Zelensky warned the talks could prove a Yalta-like "redistribution of spheres of influence" for the 21st century.

[Source 3 — www.washingtontimes.com (Bias: Right / Conservative)] (URL: https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/13/trump-attend-trilateral-meeting-xi-putin-china-white-house-confirms/):
Trump to attend trilateral meeting with Xi, Putin in China, White House confirms

President Trump is jetting to Asia on Monday for high-level meetings in the Philippines and China that will conclude with a major trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
